method: 1 independent fresh-browser arms, 36 loads each (4 cycles of 9). Actual confirmed slot loads for game arms; validated checkpoints, not narrative playthrough. Fixed viewport vs original periodic 768/1440 resize vs same-town reload; decode-only native-image control uses the first arm live image sets with no game/canvas. No allocation/CPU profiler attached. Forced GC and live-object queries at checkpoints outside loading; whole-browser Linux PSS, not game-only RAM or a phone budget. 30 seconds natural idle precedes diagnostic critical pressure; forced reclamation is not acceptance. Detailed memory-infra tracing is opt-in and identified in configuration.

fullTrace.location: Execution-only /tmp/lantern-followup-raw; regenerate using the documented native trace command. Published allocator excerpt omits mmap addresses and ownership graphs.

arms.allocatorEvidenceNote: Original allocator values/process totals, in chronological trace-id groups. Chrome normalizes request GUIDs in exported trace; the three successful explicit requests correspond to the three allocator groups by order. Hierarchical paths and shared-memory aliases must not be added together.
